entry.name: Supermium
entry.verified: Supermium (win32ss); binary unsigned, no published checksums checked (preinstalled); driver: zip MD5 matches storage.googleapis.com x-goog-hash (tEekyyOvUdqCcvbYZ7mxxw==); chromedriver.exe unsigned, no checksum file published
entry.notes: driver is a 1-line .cmd wrapper running chromedriver.exe --disable-build-check %* (plain chromedriver 109 refuses: 'only supports Chrome version 109, current 126.0.6478.256'). Same-major chromedriver 126.0.6478.182 (CfT) never starts on Win7 (hangs silently, no output). Stop it with taskkill /F /IM chromedriver.exe as usual. UA reports HeadlessChrome/130 on Windows NT 10.0 (Supermium spoof).
